description: The v2 path validates the resource with unknown-field rejection forced off, so keys the resource schema does not define are accepted.
author: grok-4.7-medium-fast
why_hard: The resource schema still defaults unknown-field rejection on, and a v2 test still rejects an unknown sibling of data.object, but the mapper calls RESOURCE.validate with reject_unknown=False, which is what admits hosted_invoice_url and lines.
